credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach. Botanical reference: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Utricularia . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Utricularia vulgaris, floating (free-floating, rootless). COILED: a floating tangle of finely forked thread-like leaves hangs from a stolon just under a white water line, with five tiny pale bladder traps; the curled stem tip coils up out of the water toward the foe. Water-green leaves in the dark slot, pale bladder green in the mid slot; the water line is white highlights only. Gesture: VACUUM TRAP, one bladder is set, then snaps (inflates and gulps, a tiny white water swirl at its door), and the lace sways, rebounds and settles. Sport: bronze-red anthocyanin leaves of plants in sunny, nutrient-poor water, a natural colour form, not a named cultivar.
